appearances.snippet: It departs Wilmington, Delaware, heads back to Cairo. On August 3rd, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Erika (Erika Kirk) land in Bedford, New York for the Hamptons retreat. ... Um, that's one of the partner Egyptian planes that I have on there, August 5th and sit through six, the Hamptons retreat, which Charlie (Charlie Kirk) will describe as an intervention. ... And you can go and listen to his comments after the retreat on the Megyn Kelly show. The influencers trip is sponsored by Bill Ackman, the very person that Tucker Carlson called out on stage during that time, Bibi Netanyahu (Benjamin Netanyahu), who did not kill Charlie Kirk.
